text.arabic_uthmani: وَلَمَن صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمِنْ عَزْمِ ٱلْأُمُورِ

words.gloss_range: resumptive and coordinating link into the prior response-to-wrong discourse
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens 42:43 as a continuation, not as a detached maxim. It keeps the patience-and-forgiveness case inside the prior liability discourse while branching into a higher alternative response. Because the connector is fused into the quick opening sequence, the ayah enters already linked, marked, and moving toward a confirmed evaluation.

topics.headline: continuation into a higher branch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that patience and pardon answer the preceding wrong-and-liability discourse rather than replacing it with an abstract slogan.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a coordinating conjunction, and the attachment profile keeps the opening clause tied to the preceding discourse as a condition-like first member.

topics.headline: fused opening onset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah begin with a compact ramp from linkage into emphasis before the ethical verbs arrive.
topics.reason: The connector is a prefixed particle in the opening cluster and introduces a clause later reinforced by emphatic particles.

words.gloss_range: emphatic prefix before the open subject, not a root-bearing preposition here
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) front-loads emphasis onto the whoever-profile before either act is named. It is not governing a genitive here; it marks the case as weighty from the start. The later predicate-side {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) answers this opening pressure, so the person-profile and the final classification are tied by a two-point emphasis frame.

topics.headline: case-weight before conduct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the whoever-case is marked as significant before the verbs specify the conduct.
topics.reason: The QAC grammar identifies this as emphatic lām before the relative or conditional pronoun, not a lexical root-bearing preposition.

topics.headline: opening lām anticipates verdict lām
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an intra-ayah echo that moves from the marked subject-profile to the later verdict about that profile.
topics.reason: The opening emphatic particle and the later predicate lām form matching reinforcement points around the ayah's evaluation.

words.gloss_range: open relative or conditional pronoun defining a person through the following paired acts
words.prose: {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) opens the agent slot to anyone, but it is not loose praise. The same pronoun supplies the subject for both following perfect verbs, so the profile is defined by restraint plus forgiveness together. This shifts attention from the prior wrongdoer class to the injured responder without erasing the earlier liability frame.

topics.headline: open agent restricted by conduct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that anyone may enter the profile, but only through the paired action that the ayah is about to classify.
topics.reason: QAC allows relative or conditional function, and the clause structure makes the later evaluation answer the profile defined by the two verbs.

topics.headline: one subject for two acts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that patience alone and forgiveness alone are not split into separate cases; one agent is defined by both.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence assigns the pronoun as subject of both coordinated perfect verbs.

topics.headline: from wrongdoer class to responder profile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the discourse pivot from the prior class of wrongdoers to the open profile of the harmed person who chooses restraint and pardon.
topics.reason: The pronoun begins the condition-like first member after the resumptive opening and before the evaluative clause.

words.gloss_range: Form I perfect of active endurance and restraint under provocation, locally objectless
words.root_gloss_range: patience, endurance, perseverance, and restraint; local context selects disciplined self-restraint before forgiveness
words.prose: {{ar:صَبَرَ}} ({{tr:ṣabara}}) presents restraint as an achieved act by the whoever-agent, not as a command or a passive state. Its objectless form leaves the field of injury, self-control, and withheld retaliation open from the prior discourse. Placed first in the two-verb conduct unit, it makes forgiveness arise from disciplined non-retaliation, and its links with resolve-language in 31:17 and 46:35 help explain why this restraint can be classified as firm resolve. Its heavier consonantal texture also lets the act sound compressed and held before the following movement into covering.

topics.headline: achieved restraint under pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices patience as active self-command under injury, while local grammar keeps it objectless and achieved rather than imperative.
topics.reason: The form is a third-person Form I perfect with no object, so broader patience language is locally narrowed to performed restraint in the response-to-wrong frame.

topics.headline: restraint before pardon
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that pardon is not untested softness; it comes after the first act of controlled restraint.
topics.reason: The two perfect verbs share one subject and are coordinated in sequence, with this verb occupying the first slot.

topics.headline: patience joins the resolve field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the patience-root is not isolated; it enters a broader patience-and-resolve field that 42:43 specializes with forgiveness.
topics.reason: The contextual rows support links between the patience root, forgiveness, resolve, and affair language; the cited parallels are echoes, not controls on the local parse.

topics.headline: refusal to continue wrongdoing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices restraint as a boundary-level moral alternative: injury does not have to produce another cycle of wrongdoing.
topics.reason: The prior ayah's liability frame makes objectless restraint read as the harmed person's self-governance rather than generic waiting.

topics.headline: heavy sound for restraint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first verb as heavier and more compressed before the second verb opens into covering.
topics.reason: The sound observation supports the structural move from restraint to pardon without altering the lexical sense.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector between the two perfect verbs under one subject
words.prose: The middle {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is small but structurally decisive. It joins the two perfect verbs under the same open pronoun, making two distinct acts into one profile without collapsing them into a single verb idea. The connector becomes the hinge from inward restraint to outward covering.

topics.headline: two acts under one subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the praised profile requires the coordinated pair, not patience or pardon detached from the other.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the second verb as conjoined with the first, both governed by the same open pronoun.

topics.headline: audible hinge between roots
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a balanced transition that lets restraint and covering remain distinct inside one conduct frame.
topics.reason: The prefixed conjunction is attached to the second verb and functions as the local pivot between the two perfects.

words.gloss_range: Form I perfect of human forgiveness or covering, locally objectless after restraint
words.root_gloss_range: forgive, cover, conceal, shield, remit; local context selects human pardon as protective covering without naming a specific object
words.prose: {{ar:غَفَرَ}} ({{tr:ghafara}}) completes the conduct unit as a human act of covering and pardon. The verb normally can take an object, but none is expressed here, so the offense, offender, claim, and liability remain recoverable from the prior discourse without being narrowed to only one object. As the second perfect after restraint, it hands patient forgiveness as a whole to the following demonstrative for classification as resolve. Its guttural opening gives the second act an audible turn from compressed restraint into broader covering.

topics.headline: objectless human covering
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices forgiveness as active covering after injury, while the omitted object keeps offense, offender, and claim open.
topics.reason: The verb is Form I perfect with the same subject as the first verb; attachment evidence specifically notes objectless use for a verb that normally permits an object.

topics.headline: human Form I against forgiveness horizon
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a human subject directly performing the covering act, while divine forgiveness language remains a broader root horizon rather than the local grammar.
topics.reason: The local surface is a human Form I perfect, not a seeking-forgiveness form or divine-name construction.

topics.headline: second verb completes the deed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the demonstrative evaluates patient forgiveness as a composite act, not endurance alone.
topics.reason: The second verb closes the coordinated unit that the following demonstrative resumes.

topics.headline: pardon enters resolve field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that forgiveness answers wrongdoing by covering rather than by extending the counter-claim cycle.
topics.reason: The supplied echoes and boundary rows support the move from prior injury to local covering, while the local objectless verb keeps the scope open.

topics.headline: sound opens from restraint to covering
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the second verb as a distinct acoustic turn after the heavier restraint verb.
topics.reason: The phonetic observation supports the two-part movement without changing the grammatical analysis.

words.gloss_range: emphatic annulling particle opening the evaluative nominal clause
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) pivots from the conduct clause to formal judgment. It governs the following demonstrative and opens a nominal classification whose predicate is the later lām-marked prepositional phrase. The effect is not a bare compliment; the syntax confirms and stabilizes the claim that the paired act belongs to resolve-bearing affairs. The doubled nūn gives that hinge a compact audible weight.

topics.headline: pivot from act to judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah stop describing the responder and begin formally evaluating the completed pair.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the demonstrative the complement of this particle and the following phrase the evaluative predicate.

topics.headline: stacked confirmation stabilizes the verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that forgiveness after harm is grammatically protected from being reread as mere weakness or casual praise.
topics.reason: The construction combines this particle with a predicate-side emphatic lām and a prepositional predicate.

topics.headline: compressed confirmatory sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the confirmation particle as a compact hinge into the verdict.
topics.reason: The form-specific sound observation supports the particle's confirmatory role without adding a new grammatical claim.

words.gloss_range: demonstrative pronoun resuming the preceding patience-and-forgiveness action as one evaluable unit
words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) compresses the two completed acts into one referent. The singular demonstrative points back to the patience-and-forgiveness pair, then lets that paired deed function as the subject of the evaluation. Its distal form also gives the near action conceptual lift: this deed is set before the reader as a thing to be classified.

topics.headline: two verbs packaged as one deed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verdict applies to patient forgiveness as a combined deed, not to either verb alone.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the demonstrative as resuming the preceding patience-and-forgiveness action.

topics.headline: near act lifted for judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the just-mentioned action made identifiable and elevated before its classification.
topics.reason: The demonstrative is the local pointer to the prior action and functions within the emphatic evaluation clause.

topics.headline: action sequence becomes nominal subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the grammar convert a sequence of actions into the subject of a stable ethical predicate.
topics.reason: The demonstrative stands after the emphatic particle and before the predicate phrase, carrying the action unit into classification.

words.gloss_range: predicate-side emphatic lām attached to the classificatory prepositional phrase
words.prose: The second {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) renews emphasis at the verdict itself. Attached to the following classificatory preposition, it makes the assertion and the class-membership arrive together: the packaged deed is indeed among resolve-bearing affairs. It also answers the opening {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}), moving the ayah's pressure from the whoever-case to the final classification.

topics.headline: verdict-side reinforcement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the strongest reinforcement lands on the classification, not merely on the person who acts.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as emphatic lām attached to the predicate phrase after the confirming particle.

topics.headline: opening emphasis answered at the close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a sound-and-structure echo that brackets the ayah from marked case to confirmed verdict.
topics.reason: The bound form joins the lām to the classificatory preposition and echoes the earlier emphatic lām before the pronoun.

words.gloss_range: classificatory and partitive preposition in the predicate phrase
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) supplies the classificatory hinge of the closing predicate. It does not make patient forgiveness the whole category; it places the packaged deed among the affairs of firm resolve. Because the prepositional predicate is compact and copula-less, the ayah lands with concise force: this belongs in that serious class.

topics.headline: inclusion among resolve-bearing affairs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a precise claim of class-membership: the deed belongs among resolve-bearing affairs without exhausting the category.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the following genitive phrase in the predicate, so source-like possibilities are narrowed to partitive and classificatory inclusion.

topics.headline: compressed evaluative landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that no extra verb dilutes the verdict; the compact phrase makes belonging-to-the-class the main assertion.
topics.reason: The predicate is a prepositional phrase under the confirming clause, with the copular relation left implicit.

topics.headline: classification after the action package
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah wait until the paired deed has been packaged before assigning it to the elevated category.
topics.reason: The preposition appears after the demonstrative and attached emphasis, forming the delayed final valuation.

words.gloss_range: genitive verbal noun denoting firm resolve or settled determination in the closing predicate
words.root_gloss_range: resolve, determination, settled will, decisive purpose, and binding commitment; local phrase selects firm resolve under pressure
words.prose: {{ar:عَزْمِ}} ({{tr:ʿazmi}}) is the word that hardens the closing valuation. As a genitive verbal noun at the head of the closing construct, it classifies the paired act rather than issuing a new command to be resolved. Its firmness range makes forgiveness after injury sound like settled strength, not collapse, and the phrase's recurrence with patience in 3:186 and 31:17 makes 42:43's addition of forgiveness feel deliberate. Because the resolve-root is comparatively uncommon here, the short compressed word makes the closing approval sound marked rather than generic.

topics.headline: resolve as predicate content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that resolve is the category into which the demonstrative deed is placed through the closing construct phrase.
topics.reason: The noun is governed by the preposition and heads the construct with the following genitive plural.

topics.headline: firm decision after injury
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices pardon reclassified as settled strength after deliberation, while the local phrase keeps the sense in firm resolve rather than every possible decision branch.
topics.reason: The lexical range supports firmness and decisive resolve, and the response-to-injury context selects that branch against a weakness reading.

topics.headline: verbal noun classifies rather than commands
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah naming the deed's quality instead of interrupting the evaluation with a direct imperative.
topics.reason: The local form is a singular abstract verbal noun in construct, not an imperative or finite verb.

topics.headline: constrained patience-resolve phrase field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 42:43 reuses a patience-and-resolve formula from 3:186 and 31:17, but now forgiveness occupies the companion slot.
topics.reason: The supplied inter-ayah rows give concrete references for the phrase field; they support echo and specialization, not replacement of the local grammar.

topics.headline: rare root gives marked close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah spends a comparatively uncommon resolve-root on pardon after injury, making the evaluation marked rather than generic.
topics.reason: The contextual profile shows a low-count gerund pattern and the CRITICAL rows attach that scarcity to the closing valuation.

topics.headline: from punishment to inner resolve
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the discourse move from external punitive consequence to the inner rank of a chosen response.
topics.reason: The prior consequence frame and the closing resolve predicate create a contrast in moral registers.

topics.headline: compressed firm sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a short compressed word carry the firmness that the predicate names.
topics.reason: The sound observation reinforces the closing semantic role without governing lexical sense.

words.gloss_range: definite plural genitive meaning recognized consequential affairs or matters in the closing construct
words.root_gloss_range: affair, matter, command, order, concern, event, and decision; local plural construct selects a recognized domain of serious affairs
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأُمُورِ}} ({{tr:al-ʾumūri}}) completes the closing construct as the recognized domain of consequential affairs. It is genitive, definite, and plural, so it does not act as the subject of resolve and it does not reduce the verdict to one isolated command. The final word widens one private act of restraint and covering into a governance-level class of serious matters, while the phrase echo with 3:186 and 31:17 keeps patience and resolve in view. Its hamza onset and lengthened close give that widening a distinct measured landing.

topics.headline: recognized domain of affairs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one act of patient forgiveness placed inside a recognized plural domain of consequential affairs.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as a definite plural genitive completing the construct with the preceding verbal noun.

topics.headline: domain not actor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that affairs specify the domain characterized by resolve; they are not performing the resolve themselves.
topics.reason: The attachment parse makes this word the genitive complement of the construct, not the subject or object of a verb.

topics.headline: affair range gains governance force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices non-retaliation framed as governance of a consequential matter, while the local plural keeps affair rather than command as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The root range includes command and affair fields, but the local noun is plural in a resolve construct, narrowing the payoff to serious affairs with executive weight.

topics.headline: private response widened at the landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final word expand the harmed person's response into a maxim-like category of serious moral decisions.
topics.reason: The plural noun lands at the end of the predicate phrase and generalizes the specific whoever-clause.

topics.headline: phrase echo and lām bookend
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the closing noun complete the known resolve-affairs phrase echoed in 3:186 and 31:17 and answer the opening lām-marked frame.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete references for the phrase echo and identify the opening and closing emphatic frames.

topics.headline: from public wrong to governed affair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from public oppression to inward restraint and then outward again into the domain of serious affairs.
topics.reason: The boundary rows connect the closing domain of affairs with the previous punitive-consequence register and same-surah affair vocabulary.

topics.headline: measured final cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final word give the widened classification a distinct measured landing.
topics.reason: The sound rows concern final cadence and support the word's closing role without adding a new lexical branch.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired focus verbs at words 2-3 are gathered by the demonstrative and classified through words 7-8.
baseline_models.mechanism: Self-restraint brakes reactive agitation; forgiveness then shields the offender from the fault's punitive afterlife. Resolve makes this paired response a settled handling of the affair rather than a passing mood.

activation_trace.role: Confining the self supplies the brake on panic and retaliatory impulse.
Sheltering a wrongdoer from the fault's effect supplies the release from punitive follow-through.
Binding the heart and cutting off hesitation makes restraint and forgiveness one decided response.
The scope of a concrete matter locates the response in practical conduct, not sentiment alone.

changed_reading.before: Patience and forgiveness are two adjacent virtues.
changed_reading.after: They form one governed sequence: contain the reactive self, then stop the offense from continuing through punishment, by a settled decision.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 2-3 can be read through boundary and covering images, while word 7 supplies continued direction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Patience gives an injury sides and a limit; forgiveness lays a protective cover over what has been contained. That enclosure prevents the injury from leaking into future action while resolve keeps the agent moving on a chosen course.

activation_trace.role: The sides of a vessel or grave supply a bounded container for the injury.
A preserving cover seals what has been bounded so it does not spread.
Persisting on a route without turning supplies forward continuity after containment.
The affair is the practical field whose damage must be contained and carried forward.

changed_reading.before: The pair means passively bearing harm and overlooking it.
changed_reading.after: The pair actively bounds and covers harm so it cannot govern the next action, while the agent stays on course.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The roots at words 2, 7, and 8 each contain branches of guarantee, binding duty, and command.
baseline_models.mechanism: The patient person becomes guarantor of a non-reactive response, and forgiveness is carried as an assumed obligation. Resolve turns that self-undertaking into a claim the agent accepts against the self.

activation_trace.role: Guarantee and accompaniment supply the image of personally underwriting the response.
Protecting the offender from the fault's effect specifies what the undertaking performs.
A binding duty or right makes the undertaking more than voluntary softness.
Command and obligation supply the normative pressure carried by the matter.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness is optional generosity when temperament permits.
changed_reading.after: The agent can undertake non-retaliation as a binding responsibility and become answerable for carrying it through.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah places threatened cosmic splitting beside requested forgiveness, then depicts social scattering driven by transgressive rivalry. The focus pair can therefore function as anti-fracture work: patience bounds the stress and forgiveness covers the breach before grievance divides the shared order.

activation_trace.role: A structure's sides supply the containing boundary that keeps stress localized.
A preserving cover supplies the treatment of a breach after it has been bounded.
Opening and splitting provide the image of a stressed order nearly coming apart.
Scattering into parts transfers the fracture image from the cosmos to a community.
Overstepping through aggression supplies the social pressure that drives separation.

structural_cues: 42:5 places requested forgiveness beside a heaven nearly splitting; 42:13-14 repeat separation and locate its motive in overreach after knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies splitting, scattering, aggression, boundary, and covering images. I infer that uncontained grievance propagates as fracture; a live alternative is that the cosmic and communal scenes remain independent warnings.

changed_reading.before: Patience and forgiveness regulate one person's inward state.
changed_reading.after: They are load-bearing practices that keep a stressed common order from splitting along the line of grievance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Difference sends parties onto divergent paths; judgment is then referred beyond them and the affair is entrusted. Forgiveness becomes a transfer of final jurisdiction: the injured person need not call the wrong unreal, but stops acting as its ultimate judge and executor.

activation_trace.role: Shielding from the fault's effect marks the practical suspension of personal enforcement.
A settled decision makes relinquished jurisdiction durable rather than evasive.
Each party taking a different path supplies the conflict that demands adjudication.
Judgment between people identifies the authority being transferred.
Handing an affair to another supplies the act of relinquishing final control.

structural_cues: 42:10 moves in one sentence from disagreement to judgment belonging to God, then to entrusting oneself to him.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divergent paths, adjudication, and transfer of an affair. I infer that forgiving can retire the self from final enforcement; the alternative is that entrusting concerns doctrinal disputes only.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness settles the wrong by privately declaring it closed.
changed_reading.after: Forgiveness can leave the wrong true while relinquishing personal final jurisdiction over its disposition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context preserves causal attribution to what people acquire and what their hands advance, yet repeatedly inserts pardon. Forgiveness thus does not erase agency; it interrupts the transmission of an earned consequence to the responsible person.

activation_trace.role: Protection from a fault's effect supplies the focus mechanism of blocked consequence.
Leaving punishment and effacing the offense establishes pardon as non-enforcement.
Acquiring the result through one's own action preserves responsibility.
What the hands earn makes the causal source explicit rather than concealed.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Forgiveness after injury is bound resolve, not weak drift.** Lexical evidence: ص ب ر `B001` (self-restraint from panic), غ ف ر `B002` (shielding from consequence), ع ز م `B001` (binding the heart to a matter) and `B004` (keeping a chosen course), and ء م ر `B001` (affair). Abductive move: I infer that restraint must actively hold both panic and retaliatory capacity to a chosen course. Reading change: forgiveness and resistance remain co-valid; this ayah marks the former as a demanding exercise of agency.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 42:44–47 make the cost of timing visible: once consequence is seen, there is no patron, return-road, or refuge. That later closure makes present forgiveness more clearly a difficult choice exercised while alternatives still exist.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Forgiveness is a firmly bound decision made while redress remains possible.** **Lexical evidence:** ص ب ر `B001` (self-restraint from panic), غ ف ر `B002` (forgiving and shielding from consequence), and ع ز م `B001` (firm resolve by binding the heart), anchored in صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ ... عَزْمِ. **Structural cue:** 42:39-42 have just preserved the right of defense, capped recompense, and assigned liability; the fixed ayah therefore speaks after power to respond has been recognized. **Assigned role:** patience restrains impulse, forgiveness shields the offender from consequence, and resolve binds the chosen course against wavering. **Abductive move:** I infer that forgiveness is strength under available alternatives, not inability to retaliate. **Reading change:** the pair becomes a demanding act of governance over one's own valid claim.
2. **A matter becomes firm by refusing reactive oscillation.** **Lexical evidence:** ء م ر `B001` (matter or affair) in ٱلْأُمُورِ and ع ز م `B004` (keeping to a chosen course) remains activated beside `B001`. **Structural cue:** consultation in 42:38 and the branching options in 42:40 lead here to a settled course; 42:44 then depicts a too-late wish for return. **Assigned role:** resolve converts deliberated alternatives into a stable matter. **Abductive move:** I infer that firmness is procedural, arriving after conflict and choice. **Reading change:** عَزْمِ ٱلْأُمُورِ names matters whose ethical direction has been stabilized, not merely "important things."
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 42:44's belated request for a return route made timely resolve newly visible: firmness must precede forced sight. 42:48's messenger-role boundary also corrected forgiveness from attempted control of others to governance of one's own valid claim.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi doğrudan kış mevsiminin çok sert soğuğunu ve bu soğuk sırasında gelme örneğini verir. Anlam genel bir yıkım veya ruhsal dayanma değildir; mevsim ve sıcaklık niteliğiyle sınırlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal mevsim ve sıcaklıkla sınırlıdır; komşu dal ise fiziksel soğuk gerektirmeyen, kaçışsız bir tehlike ya da sıkıntı durumudur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli bir ağacın sıkılıp yoğunlaştırılmış özünü ve bunun acı bir ilaç olarak kullanımını verir. Bu gönderge ekşi bir ağaç meyvesinden ve ruhsal dayanma anlamından ayrıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik sınıf çıplak daldır; tanım yalnızca bitkiden elde edilen acı öz ve ilaç anlamını taşır.

facets.statement: Madde bir ağacın çıkarılmış ve yoğunlaştırılmış özsuyudur.
Tadı acıdır ve ilaç olarak kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar göndergeyi bir ağacın acı özsuyu ve bu özden oluşan ilaç olarak tanımlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bitkiden çıkarılan acı öz ile bunun ilaç niteliğini birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Ağaç kökenini, öz maddeyi ve acı niteliğini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: acı ağaç özü ve bundan yapılan ilaç

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal belirli bir ağacın çok ekşi ve çekirdekli meyvesini belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bitki kökenli, keskin tatlı bir maddeyi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal işlenmiş özsu ve ilaçtır; komşu dal ise ağacın yenilebilir ya da kullanılan meyvesidir ve tadı acı değil belirgin biçimde ekşidir.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal belirli ağacın çok ekşi meyvesidir; acı özsu, taş ve tıkaç anlamları bu sınırın dışındadır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; ekşi meyve ile acı bitki özü arasındaki ayrım anlam sınırını en açık biçimde gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi beyaz bulutu, yoğun bulutun üzerinde düz duran bulut katmanını ve basamaklar gibi üst üste yığılan bulutları birlikte verir. Çekirdek bulutun beyazlığı ve katmanlı yığılmasıdır; genel yığın yapma eylemi bu dala ancak karşılaştırma düzeyinde yaklaşır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal beyaz ve katmanlı buluta özgüdür; genel yığılma, yağmur adı ve başka nesne adları kapsam dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik sınıf çıplak daldır; tanım yalnızca beyaz, düz katmanlı veya üst üste yığılmış bulut anlamını kapsar.

concept_map.definition: Yoğun bir bulut tabakasının üstünde düz duran ya da kat kat üst üste yığılan beyaz buluttur.

facets.statement: Gönderge beyaz bir buluttur.
Bulut yoğun bir tabakanın üstünde düz durur veya basamaklar gibi üst üste yığılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Beyazlık ile düz ya da basamaklı üst üste yığılma özelliklerini birlikte karşılar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal belirli bir doğal nesnenin görünüşünü adlandırır; komşu dal ise nesne türüyle sınırlı olmayan genel bir toplama ve yığma sürecidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir nesne sınıfı değil, sofra altına serilen geniş ince parça ile üst üste konmuş yiyecek yığını ve ölçmeden yapılan alış biçimini yan yana verir. Dal korunabilir, ancak tanım bunları birleşik bir nesne gibi sunmamalı; ayrı sözlüksel yüzler olarak göstermelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: İnce sofra yaygısı, yiyecek yığını ve ölçüsüz toplu alım ayrı yüzlerdir; tek bir birleşik nesne sayılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik sınıf karma çıplak olmayan daldır; sofra yaygısı ve yığın yüzleri, ölçmeden satın alma kalıbından açıkça ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: Sözlüksel aile, yiyeceğin altına serilen geniş ince parçayı ve üst üste konmuş yiyecek yığınını ayrı ayrı adlandırır. Kalıba bağlı kullanım, malı tartmadan veya ölçmeden topluca satın almayı bildirir.

facets.statement: Bir kullanım, yiyeceğin altına serilen geniş ve ince parçayı belirtir.
Başka bir kullanım, yiyeceğin parçaları üst üste konularak oluşan yığını belirtir.
Satın alma kalıbında mal tartılmadan ve ölçülmeden toplu halde alınır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak ifadesi sofra altında kullanılan geniş ince parçayı, üst üste konmuş yiyecek yığınını ve malın ölçülmeden topluca alınmasını ayrı kullanımlar olarak verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi önceki bir öldürmeye karşılık aynı cezayı isteme ve yetkilinin suçluyu bu karşılıkla öldürmesi işlemlerini verir. Anlam, birini öldürülmek üzere yalnızca bağlı tutmaktan ayrılır; kurucu ilişki önceki suç ile ona denk verilen ölüm cezasıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli bir şaşma kalıbını, ateşe götüren işleri yapmaktaki gözü peklik ya da pervasızlık olarak yorumlar. Bu gerçek bir dayanıklılık övgüsü değildir; sözün biçiminden doğan özel ve yergili bir kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Kişiler ağır sonuca götüren işleri çekinmeden yapar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar belirli şaşma sözünü, kişilerin ateşe götüren işleri yapmaktaki gözü pekliği ve pervasızlığı olarak açıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnızca kaynakta verilen şaşma kalıbının yergili ve sonuca dönük yorumunda kullanılır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi örterek görünürlükten, kirden ya da zarardan korumak ve bu işi gören örtü veya koruyucu katmanı belirtmektir. Bazı kullanımlar, eşyayı kaba koyma ya da bir işi gereken biçimde örtüp düzeltme gibi belirli yapılara bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, bir şeyi örterek onu dış etkiden korumak ya da görünmez kılmaktır.
Başı koruyan zırh başlığı, başörtüsünü yağdan sakınan bez, yay çentiğindeki yama ve başka bir bulutu örten bulut bu çekirdeğin özel örnekleridir.
Eşyayı bir kaba koyma, kumaşı kiri daha iyi gizler duruma getirme ve bir işi uygun biçimde örtüp düzeltme yalnızca belirtilen yapılarda geçerlidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar örtme ile korumayı ortak çekirdek sayar; koruyucu başlık ve çeşitli bez ya da örtü türleri bu çekirdeği somutlaştırırken kap, kumaş ve iş düzenleme kullanımları belirli yapılara bağlı kalır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir yolcunun tuttuğu rotada ilerlemesini ve bağlama göre atın koşusunu dizgine aldırmadan sürdürmesini anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Fiili hareketi, yönü sürdürmeyi ve dönmeme koşulunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir yolcunun seçtiği yol veya yönde kesintisiz biçimde ilerlediği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yol tutmayı, ilerlemeyi ve yön değiştirmemeyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Atın binicinin yavaşlatma girişimine karşı koşusunu sürdürdüğü bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Atın koşuyu sürdürmesini ve dizgine karşılık vermemesini korur.
Belirlenen yönden vazgeçmeme düşüncesini kısmen korur.
error_profile.loses: Yolda veya koşuda gerçekleşen fiili ilerlemeyi kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Hareketten önce verilen zihinsel karar anlamını öne çıkarır.
error_profile.collision: Kökün kesin karar bildiren ayrı dalıyla karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da geri çevrilmeye aldırmadan ilerlemeyi sürdürür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yol ve koşu hareketine bağlıdır; komşu dal hem işte hem seyirde sürdürmeyi kapsayan daha geniş bir ilerleme alanına sahiptir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yolcunun seçtiği yönde bilinçli biçimde ilerlemesi bu dalda korunur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Hayvanın biniciye üstün gelmesi, şeyin güçlü biçimde kontrolden çıkması ve geminin rotasından sapması komşu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Atın durdurulamayan koşusu iki dalın kesiştiği bölgedir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın insan kullanımında yönü tutma vardır; komşu dalın çekirdeği ise hareket eden varlığın denetimi aşarak kendi gidişini dayatmasıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, uygulanması zorunlu kılınmış görevleri, hakları ve hükümleri; yönetici buyruğuna uyma, tanrısal yükümlülük ve belirli bir yere kapanma buyruğu örnekleriyle açıkça destekler.

concept_map.definition: Yetkili bir buyruk veya hükümle uygulanması zorunlu kılınmış görev, hak ya da davranıştır; yöneticiye uyma, tanrısal yükümlülükler ve belirli ibadet buyrukları bunun özel alanlarıdır.

Kutsal metnin belirli yerlerinde yere kapanma buyruğu, bağlayıcı davranışa örnek verilir.
